# x264 / libx264

Machining's bundled FFmpeg runtime is built with x264 / libx264 enabled for
H.264 encoding.

Upstream source:

- <https://code.videolan.org/videolan/x264>
- <https://www.videolan.org/developers/x264.html>

x264 is GPL-licensed. Because Machining distributes an FFmpeg runtime with
x264 enabled, release packages follow the GPLv3-or-later source and license
delivery path documented in legal/SOURCE_OFFER.md.
